map.耳训练器基于 Web Audio API 播放音程与和弦并训练听音辨识，反复练习: The ear trainer plays intervals and chords via the Web Audio API and trains listening recognition; repeated practice improves solfege and the aural foundation for improvisation, suited to music learners.
map.听两个音判音程（小二度到大七度），练相对音感: Hear two notes and judge the interval (minor second to major seventh) to train relative pitch
map.听和弦判类型（大/小/属七等），提升和声辨识: Hear a chord and judge its type (major/minor/dominant seventh, etc.) to improve harmony recognition
map.反复随机出题并即时反馈，建立音程与听感的映射: Repeated random quizzes with instant feedback build the mapping between intervals and hearing.
map.：相邻音名半音差：小二度 1、大二度 2、小三度 3、大三度 4、纯四度 5、三: : semitone differences between adjacent note names: minor 2nd 1, major 2nd 2, minor 3rd 3, major 3rd 4, perfect 4th 5, tritone 6, perfect 5th 7, minor 6th 8, major 6th 9, minor 7th 10, major 7th 11, octave 12.
map.：同时响 C-E-G 为大三（明亮）、C-E♭-G 为小三（柔和）、C-E-G-: : sounding C-E-G together is major (bright), C-Eb-G minor (soft), C-E-G-Bb dominant seventh (with tension); distinguish by color and completeness.
map.从纯五度、大三度等色彩鲜明的音程入手，记住参照曲（如《星球大战》开头纯五度），再: Start with coloristic intervals like the perfect fifth and major third, memorize reference tunes (e.g., the opening perfect fifth of Star Wars), then expand to all semitone steps.
map.和弦辨识从哪开始？: Where to start with chord recognition?
map.先分大/小三和弦（明/暗），再加属七（解决感）、大七（爵士柔光）；每次听后看答案: First distinguish major/minor triads (bright/dark), then add dominant seventh (resolution feel) and major seventh (jazz soft glow); after each listen check the answer to build aural memory.
